description: List, enable/disable, toggle, install, reload, trigger, or uninstall browser extensions. Uses chrome.management for profile-safe management and the Chrome DevTools Protocol Extensions domain for unpacked-extension lifecycle actions.

confirmSelf.description: Explicitly allow uninstalling Agent Pilot itself

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

enableInIncognito.description: Enable an installed unpacked extension in incognito windows

enabled.description: Target enabled state for setEnabled action

path.description: Absolute path to an unpacked extension directory for install

tabId.description: Target tab used for CDP Extensions commands and triggerAction
